steps.title: The trials
steps.text: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall in Rellekka.
steps.warning: For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, game messages set to 'On', and chat timestamps on.

steps.text: [Accept Quest]
Continue speaking to Brundt the Chieftain.

actions.text: I want to become a Fremennik!

steps.title: Manni the Reveller
steps.text: Talk to Manni the Reveller.
Pick up a Keg of beer.
Pick up a beer.
Talk to the Poison Salesman at Forester's Arms in Seers' Village.
Use beer on council workman at the bridge south of Rellekka.
Light the strange object and put-inside pipe on the outside eastern wall of the Rellekka longhall.
Stand next to Manni in the longhall.
Use low alcohol keg on the keg of beer in the backpack.

postconditions.text: refill it with with low alcohol beer

steps.text: Challenge Manni.

steps.title: Olaf the Bard
steps.text: Speak to Olaf the Bard, east of the longhall.

neededItems.name: Raw shark, raw manta ray, or raw sea turtle

steps.text: Chop off a branch of the swaying tree to the south-east.
Craft the branch into an unstrung lyre.
Talk to Lalli to the south-east.
Talk to Askeladden south of the longhall.

Grab a raw potato, an onion, and cabbage from the farm in south-east Rellekka.
  • Grab an extra onion and cabbage in case you accidentally eat them.
Use the potato, onion, cabbage, and pet rock on Lalli's Stew.

Talk to Lalli to obtain a golden fleece.
  • Use the drop trick to obtain another if you plan on completing Kili's Knowledge VII.
Use the golden fleece on a spinning wheel in south-west Rellekka.
Use the wool on the unstrung lyre.
Use your raw shark, manta ray or sea turtle on the strange altar south-west of Rellekka.
Enter the backstage of the longhall through the north-east door.
Step on stage and play the enchanted lyre.

steps.title: Sigli the Huntsman
steps.text: Talk to Sigli the Huntsman near Rellekka's southern entrance.

Use the received hunters' talisman to locate and kill The Draugen.
  • The Draugen is not visible until you get close to his location.
  • Look for a tiny grey butterfly.
  • Once next to the butterfly, click on the talisman.
Return to Sigli to receive his vote.

steps.title: Swensen the Navigator
steps.text: Talk to Swensen the Navigator in his house south-west of the longhall.
Go down the ladder.
South.
West.
East.
North.
South.
East.
North.
Climb up the ladder, then talk to Swensen to receive his vote.

steps.title: Thorvald the Warrior
steps.text:
Talk to Thorvald the Warrior north of the longhall.
  • You are not allowed to bring in weapons, armour, or beasts of burden.
  • You can bring potions, food, rings of recoil, already summoned familiars, and you can remove your pickaxe/hatchet from your tool belt.

postconditions.text: spell that will do that for you

steps.text: Climb down the ladder and wait for him to appear to begin the fight.
Defeat Koschei the Deathless three times. Either kill him the fourth time or let yourself be defeated. You will not die.
Talk to Thorvald to receive his vote.

postconditions.text: impressed with your bravery in combat

steps.title: Peer the Seer
steps.text: Speak to Peer the Seer, south-west of the market in Rellekka.

Click on the door to the house. Read the riddle. The first sentence determines the answer:
RiddleAnswer
My first is in mageMind
My first is in tarTree
My first is in the wellLife
My first is in fishFire
My first is in waterTime
My first is in wizardWind
Enter the building and climb the ladder.
Open then search the south-west cupboard.
Study the unicorn's head.
Study the bull's head.
Open then search the eastern chest.
Search the bookcase.
Use the red herring on the cooking range.
Use the goop on the wooden disk.
Go down the eastern trapdoor and use the two disks on the abstract mural.
Climb the ladder.
Use the empty jug on the tap.
Use the jug on the empty bucket.
Use the empty jug on the tap again and fill the bucket.
Use the full jug on the 3/5ths full bucket.
Use the full bucket on the drain to get an empty bucket.
Use the 1/3rds full jug on the empty bucket, then Use the empty jug on the tap
Use the full jug on the 1/5ths full bucket.
Use the 4/5ths full bucket on the northwestern chest.
Use the vase on the tap.

postconditions.text: You fill the strange looking vase with water

steps.text: Use the vase lid on the vase of water.
Use the sealed vase on the frozen table.
Use the frozen key on the range.
Go down the trapdoor and exit the building.
